title: Fatigue and vascular dysfunction in lipoedema. Investigation of symptoms of myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) such as fatigue, pain and vascular dysfunction in patients with lipoedema.
summary:
Lipedema and chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS) – common causes?

Lipedema and ME/CFS (myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome) are two conditions that are often associated with severe symptoms and limitations. 
Both conditions have complex causes and similar symptoms such as fatigue, pain, sleep disorders, and problems with cardiovascular regulation. 
Despite these similarities, there has been little research to date on whether there are common causes between these two conditions.

We aim at finding out whether there are any connections between lipedema and ME/CFS. 
On that account we plan to investigate whether certain antibodies in the blood and vascular factors associated with ME/CFS are also present in people with lipedema. 
We also want to compare the symptoms and quality of life of people with lipedema and ME/CFS.
In the long term, we hope to advance diagnosis and treatment.


Methods:
The study will examine women with lipedema and a control group.
Their symptoms will then be assessed using questionnaires to obtain information about their symptoms, their state of health, and their quality of life. 
We will also analyze blood and urine samples to measure antibodies  against certain receptors associated with ME/CFS and to track hormonal influences.
Vital signs such as heart rate and blood pressure are measured to check circulatory function and obtain information about the condition of the blood vessels.

Examination procedures: 
We will use various examination procedures. These include:

* A questionnaire to asses the symptoms of ME/CFS
* A questionnaire to asses quality of life
* A blood test to measure certain antibodies
* A urine test to determine cycle status
* A pulse wave analysis and an orthostatic test to assess vascular status.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Adult women with and without lipoedema
- No ME/CFS diagnosis required in advance
- Lipoedema stages 1-3
- Untreated and non-surgically treated lipoedema
- Age between 18 and 65
- only persons capable of giving consent
Exclusion criteria:
- Lipometabolic disorders (other than lipoedema)
- Post liposuction
- Cardiac pacemaker or defibrillator
-  Cardiac diseases (myocardial infarction <6 months, severe CHD,
sre CHD, severe hypertension, severe heart failure)
- haematomas, injuries or skin diseases in the area of the
examination sites
- Connective tissue diseases / infections
- epilepsy
- Post-traumatic stress disorder
- Psychotic disorders, substance dependence, severe affective
disorders with impaired judgement
- Pregnant and breastfeeding women
- Underweight
- minors
- Patients unable to give consent
